what: Each time you hover, a white light band tilted at -25° (darkest at the 90% point of its center) sweeps once from outside the button’s left edge to outside its right edge in 1.5s (.215,.61,.355,1) — the silver button glints. For large banners you can choose 2.5s with a fainter band while the whole panel rises to brightness 1.2 and back over 1s, and for icons a glow of 8px around the edge that fades in and out over .8s. If the pointer re-enters, it restarts from the beginning

options.--fx-dur: Duration of the light band passing (via style), default 1.5s — banner 2.5s
options.--fx-shine: Light band opacity 0–1 (via style), default .9 — banner .25
options.look: If bright, the whole panel brightness also swells up to 1.2 over 1s, if glow, a glow around the edge instead of a band (icon)

from.where: index.html store Map button, other-brand banner, footer SNS, article.html back-to-list button — original .js-hover: on mouseenter it removes is-hover and re-adds it 1/60s later to replay kf-shine-bg (left -105% → 105%, 1.5s, banner 2.5s·#ffffff40), kf-brightness (1s) and kf-sns-hover (.8s).
